turns.question: How do you configure pod autoscaling for asynchronous queue depth spikes?
turns.answer: We configured KEDA with custom Prometheus metrics querying Kafka lag. We set pod disruption budgets with minAvailable 80% to prevent eviction cascades during node scale-up.

turns.question: Explain your memory management strategy in high-throughput Go services.
turns.answer: We utilized sync.Pool for zero-allocation byte buffers in serialization and implemented context timeouts with non-blocking channel selects to eliminate goroutine leaks.
criteria: Uses sync.Pool to minimize GC allocator overhead
Implements non-blocking select with timeout or context cancellation
